name: competition-paper-product-blueprint
summary: End-to-end operating workflow for turning official math modeling materials into a verified LaTeX/PDF paper using AI providers, reviewed skills, MCP-style tools, and deterministic evidence gates.

lanes.title: Contest Intake
lanes.goal: Collect the official problem, rules, data, and source constraints before any model writing begins.
lanes.gate: Every subquestion has a direct-answer target, data dependency, and rule/source dependency.

lanes.title: Method Selection
lanes.goal: Choose model families, rejected alternatives, variables, objectives, and constraints with judge-facing logic.
lanes.gate: Every selected method has a reason, a baseline, expected metric, and reproducible script path.

lanes.title: Compute And Ledger
lanes.goal: Run deterministic scripts and store exact values before writing final claims.
lanes.gate: No result enters the paper unless it is present in result-ledger with metric, value, unit, script, and source data.

lanes.title: Scientific Figures
lanes.goal: Create evidence-carrying publication-style figures with traceable scripts and caption claims.
lanes.gate: Every figure has a purpose, source data, script, caption claim, and LaTeX reference.

lanes.title: LaTeX Writing
lanes.goal: Write modular LaTeX sections from verified evidence, keeping unknown values explicit as TODO.
lanes.gate: Important claims are linked to evidence and direct-answer paragraphs exist for every problem item.

lanes.title: Submission Verification
lanes.goal: Compile, verify, inspect warnings, and package final deliverables without silent AI edits.
lanes.entry_command: python paperctl.py verify <contest-id> && python paperctl.py build <contest-id>
lanes.gate: Verification has zero FAIL, intentional WARN items are documented, and paper/main.pdf exists.

operating_rules: Do not let AI output write final files without BEGIN_FILE preview and explicit apply.
Do not install or invoke external skills until their SKILL.md has been reviewed.
Do not enable broad MCP filesystem or command access for a contest workspace.
Do not polish prose before result, figure, and claim ledgers support the claims.
Do not submit while status reports todo, blocked, or in_progress stages.

packaging_strategy.summary: Windows .cmd launcher starts Node local API and browser UI. Best for fast iteration and contest debugging.
Wrap the local UI as a smaller Windows desktop app after one real contest pilot.
Use if fastest packaging and consistent Chromium rendering matter more than binary size.
